newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rhone-Poulenc Brazil unit names new president.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc Brazil unit names new president.

text.p: Rhodia, the Brazilian unit of French chemicals group Rhone-Poulenc SA, said on Tuesday it had named Jose Carlos Grubisich Filho as its new president.
The announcement was made by the firm's current president, Edson Vaz Musa, who will retire at the end of this year after working for the company for 35 years, Rhodia said.

Grubisich Filho, 39, will take over as Rhodia's chief in January. He has worked for the Rhone-Poulenc group for 20 years in Brazil and abroad. Currently he is Rhodia's executive director at the Agribusiness division.
Rhodia is South America's main chemical and pharmaceutical complex, with units in five Brazilian states. It employs 7,000 people and has annual revenues of around $1.5 billion, the company said.
